description.ja: 「ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5」が新仕様「-ACTION-」として登場！
description.en: "ULTRAMAN SUIT Ver7.5 " is now available as a new specification "-ACTION-"!

description.ja: • 可動域の向上で、SPACIUM SWORDを使った劇中シーンをさらに迫力のポージングで再現できる。
description.en: • With improved range of motion, you can recreate scenes from the movie using SPACIUM SWORD with even more impressive poses.

description.ja: • 首パーツがボールジョイントになったことで、頭部の回転方向の可動域が大幅に拡大。
description.en: • The neck part is now a ball joint, which greatly expands the range of motion in the rotational direction of the head.

description.ja: • LEDを排除し、複数のボールジョイントで胸部と腹部を連結し可動させる新技術を採用することにより、ひねり方向の可動域の大幅アップに成功。
description.en: • By eliminating LEDs and adopting new technology that connects and moves the chest and abdomen using multiple ball joints, we have succeeded in greatly increasing the range of motion in the twisting direction.

description.ja: • 各種武装など充実のオプションパーツ付属。
description.en: • Comes with a variety of optional parts such as various weapons.
